title: Awake's tray icon doesn't respect 24h time format

status.label: Existing upstream fix
status.detail: Open PR 50905 directly targets the regional-time formatting defect.

next_action.label: Review PR 50905
next_action.reason: Do not start a second formatting design while the targeted upstream fix is open.

judgment.rationale: The issue remains an open bug, but PR 50905 explicitly closes it and changes the precise hard-coded tooltip formatting path. The prior independent design and generic diagnostic request are superseded.
evidence: The reporter supplied the requested screenshot; a September 30 comment independently shows 17:30 displayed as 5:30 without a designator.
The inspected source at src/modules/awake/Awake/Core/Manager.cs, Manager.SetModeShellIcon, uses the fixed MMM d, h:mm tt pattern.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/50905 is OPEN, explicitly closes 47359, and changes Manager.cs to culture-specific month/day and short-time formats.
judgment.recommended_action: Review and validate the existing upstream PR; no competing design or additional reporter diagnostics.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 50905 covers the reported 24-hour and missing-AM/PM tooltip path. It is open, not shipped or proven resolved.

issue_context.summary: Awake expiration tooltips use a fixed 12-hour pattern despite Windows regional time preferences; an upstream PR now addresses that exact formatting path.
known_information: The original report is on PowerToys 0.99 and includes the requested settings/tray screenshot.
A later screenshot-backed report shows a configured 17:30 rendered as 5:30.
PR 50905 is open and explicitly references this issue.
inferences: The fixed h:mm tt pattern explains why cultures with empty AM/PM designators lose both the 24-hour value and its disambiguator.
issue_context.analysis: Concrete upstream implementation coverage replaces the earlier standalone design. Open PR coverage does not mean the installed product is fixed.
initial_investigation: Read the complete body, four comments, labels, assignees, and cross-reference timeline.
Checked the owning tooltip method and read PR 50905's description, state, and changed-file list.
